methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2021, 71% of our $67.0 billion in net sales were from the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor (including 62% from the Department of Defense (DoD))' (FY2021 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend heavily on contracts with the U.S. Government for a substantial portion of our business. ... Those contracts are conditioned upon the continuing availability of Congressional appropriations.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing, ECOMMERCE (live from 2015-01-01) to e-commerce displacing physical retail, malls, grocery and distribution, STREAMING (live from 2015-08-04) to streaming displacing linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles, ENERGY_TRANSITION (live from 2015-12-12) to decarbonisation stranding oil, gas and coal reserves and refining, EV (live from 2020-01-01) to battery-electric vehicles displacing ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail, and CRYPTO (live from 2020-10-21) to crypto-assets disintermediating payments networks, banks, exchanges and remittance; the 10-K names no offshore competition, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles or crypto-assets and does not mention cloud; Lockheed Martin holds no oil, gas or coal reserves or refining, and the 10-K names oil and gas only as a market for Sikorsky's commercial helicopters ('demand for its products may be adversely affected by global economic conditions, including oil and gas trends that are outside of our control') and climate change only as a source of regulation and cost ('potential impacts relating to climate change could result in laws, regulations or policies that significantly increase our direct and indirect operational and compliance burdens') and of severe weather ('weather conditions, some of which may be exacerbated by climate-change'), so no disruption theme in scope is live

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.1%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +0.3%/yr (FY22 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.0%/yr (FY12-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct
